description: Use when an agent must act on the weather right now and be able to cite it: current conditions for any point on Earth, from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute's official model, not an aggregator. Returns temperature, humidity, pressure, wind speed and bearing, cloud cover and the next hour's precipitation, plus the exact model run it came from and the units the institute itself declares, so the figure can be checked. $0.01 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

hours.description: How many hourly steps to include after the current one, 0-24. Defaults to 6.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90. Rounded to 4 decimals, which is what the institute accepts.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, -180 to 180. Rounded to 4 decimals.

name: weather_now
title: Current weather from the official national forecast
